title: The Woman, the Dragon and the War in Heaven
description: A dramatic heavenly scene where a woman clothed with the sun gives birth to a son who is caught up to God, while a great fiery red dragon tries to devour him. This triggers a war in heaven where Michael and his angels defeat the dragon, who is Satan. The dragon is cast down to earth and pursues the woman, but she is given eagle wings and flees to the wilderness. Finally, the dragon turns its rage against the rest of her offspring.
